briefing: Stocks slipped a little today, with both the NASDAQ and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, so the market had no clear direction. Cash is $445.88, which is below the $500 needed to open a new position, and today's signal does not justify selling a winner to raise money. We are holding all seven positions and waiting for a clear up day before using the remaining cash.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor holds on purpose so they can buy when a good opportunity comes along. On a flat, no-direction day it can be better to wait than to buy something just to use up the cash. Saving that money for a strong up day tends to give better entry points.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」是指投資者刻意保留的現金，以便在出現良機時入市。在大市方向不明、表現平淡的日子，與其為了用盡現金而勉強買入，不如耐心等待。把資金留待強勢上升的日子才出手，往往能取得較理想的入市價位。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ and the S&P 500 each down about 0.3%. A move this small usually means investors are taking a breather, with some taking profits and others waiting for the next news. No news headlines were provided today, so we can't link the move to a specific event, and it is best read as normal daily ups and downs.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日窄幅偏軟，納斯達克指數與標普500指數同告下跌約0.3%。如此輕微的跌幅，通常反映投資者暫時觀望，部分資金獲利回吐，其餘則靜候下一個消息出現。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，難以將走勢歸因於個別事件，宜視為一般的日常波動。
